branches.description: The user is not currently authenticated, so logout is a no-op and the backend returns a status message indicating that no user is logged in.
The user is authenticated, so the backend clears the authenticated flag and returns a successful logout status.

mutations.logic: The backend sets the persistent authenticated flag to the constant value False.

fields.value: No user is currently logged in
fields.logic: The backend returns a literal status message when logout is requested while no user is authenticated.
The backend returns a literal status message after successfully clearing the authenticated state.
